svg.aria-description: The webhook sender's overlays, bases, and components: 12 nodes, 12 connections. 4 kustomizations, 2 overlays among them, imported from a Kustomize folder. Each frame is a kustomization with the files, patches, and generators it lists; an arrow shows what an overlay builds on or includes, and what a patch changes.
svg.font-family: pw-sans-lqw91w0wjv, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: The webhook sender's overlays, bases, and components
svg.desc: The webhook sender's overlays, bases, and components: 12 nodes, 12 connections. 4 kustomizations, 2 overlays among them, imported from a Kustomize folder. Each frame is a kustomization with the files, patches, and generators it lists; an arrow shows what an overlay builds on or includes, and what a patch changes. Nodes: - Environment: overlays/dev (Overlay) - dev (namespace webhooks-dev, prefix dev-, webhook-sender:main), service - webhook-config (ConfigMap generator), storage - Environment: overlays/prod (Overlay) - prod (namespace webhooks, webhook-sender:1.3.0, webhook-sender 3 replicas), service - webhook-redeliver (CronJob, redeliver.yaml), function - resources.yaml (Patch of Deployment webhook-sender), service - Resource group: components/tracing (Component) - tracing (kustomization.yaml), service - otel-env.yaml (Patch of Deployment webhook-sender), service - Resource group: base (Base) - base (kustomization.yaml), service - webhook-sender (Deployment, deployment.yaml), service - webhook-sender (Service, service.yaml), gateway - webhook-config (ConfigMap generator), storage - webhook-queue (Secret generator), secret Connections: - dev to base: builds on - prod to base: builds on - prod to tracing: includes - resources.yaml to webhook-sender: patches - otel-env.yaml to webhook-sender: patches - webhook-sender to webhook-config (dashed): reads - webhook-sender to webhook-config (dashed): reads - webhook-sender to webhook-queue (dashed, identity line): reads - webhook-sender to webhook-sender - webhook-redeliver to webhook-config (dashed): reads - webhook-redeliver to webhook-config (dashed): reads - webhook-redeliver to webhook-queue (dashed, identity line): reads
